entities.name: Leori
entities.description: A female patagia tiger bonded to Lukka.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A bonder who leads Coppercoat Specials and bonds with Leori.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: A city with rings, attacked by Leori and later besieged.

entities.name: Epha
entities.description: A Coppercoat who set a trap for Leori.

entities.name: Gedra
entities.description: A Coppercoat who shot Leori with a crossbow bolt.

entities.name: Jirina
entities.description: A monster hunter rescued by Leori; daughter of General Kudro.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker carried off with Lukka by Leori.

entities.name: Falk
entities.description: Holder of a skyship from which Jirina was rescued.

entities.name: Battle at the Ozolith
entities.description: A battle in which Abda and Rigi were killed.

entities.name: Siege of Drannith
entities.description: The siege started by Lukka with an army of monsters after Leori's death.

events.summary: Leori flies into Drannith's Second Ring, killing horses and Coppercoats.
events.quote: Leori flew into Drannith 's Second Ring, killing a few horses and Coppercoats

events.summary: Leori and Lukka bond in a flash of green light.
events.quote: In an instant, Leori and Lukka had bonded.

events.summary: Leori carries Lukka and Vivien Reid north to meet other bonders and joins the Battle at the Ozolith.
events.quote: she plucked both Lukka and Vivien Reid with her and flew north

events.summary: Leori rescues Jirina from Falk's skyship at Lukka's bidding.
events.quote: Lukka bid her rescue Jirina from Falk 's skyship, which she did

events.summary: Leori is pierced by ballista bolts delivering Jirina to Drannith but survives.
events.quote: Leori was pierced in several places, but survived.

events.summary: General Kudro kills Leori; her last act is to comfort Lukka through the bond.
events.quote: Kudro then took the matter into his own hands.

events.summary: Enraged by Leori's death, Lukka gathers an army of monsters to start the Siege of Drannith.
events.quote: Lukka was enraged by her death and gathered an army of monsters

relations.quote: Leori was a female patagia tiger bonded to Lukka .
Kudro then took the matter into his own hands.
General Kudro bid her daughter execute Leori
